service.description: Sigrok bridge server exposing Sipeed SLogic logic analyzers to ngscopeclient. Two TCP ports are required: the command port that the client connects to and a data port that carries the waveform stream. The data port is always the command port + 1 (10101 -> 10102 by default); if the bridge is started with a custom --port, open that port and the one above it instead.
